description.en: IVF costs $12,000 to $30,000 per cycle in Colorado in 2026. Colorado mandates IVF coverage for large-group plans. Compare clinic prices and cash-pay options.

h1.en: How Much Does IVF Cost in Colorado in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta la FIV en Colorado en 2026?

subhero.en: A single IVF cycle in Colorado costs $12,000 to $30,000 out of pocket in 2026, depending on the clinic and protocol. Colorado's Building Families Act requires large-group fully-insured health plans to cover up to three egg retrievals and unlimited embryo transfers, but self-insured employer plans, small-group plans, and individual plans under many circumstances remain exempt. Patients who do not have mandate-covered insurance pay the full cash price themselves.
subhero.es: Un solo ciclo de FIV en Colorado cuesta entre $12,000 y $30,000 de su propio bolsillo en 2026, segun la clinica y el protocolo. La Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado exige que los planes de grupo grande totalmente asegurados cubran hasta tres recuperaciones de ovulos y transferencias ilimitadas de embriones, pero los planes de empleadores autoasegurados, planes de grupo pequeno y planes individuales en muchas circunstancias siguen exentos.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, a standard IVF cycle in Colorado costs $12,000 to $17,500 for the base procedure at most clinics, plus $3,000 to $9,000 in fertility medications, for a realistic all-in range of $15,000 to $30,000 per cycle. Colorado's Building Families Act (HB20-1158, effective January 2023, expanded by HB24-1025 effective January 2025) mandates IVF coverage for fully-insured large-group and, as of 2025, small-group and individual plans regulated by the state, covering three egg retrievals and unlimited embryo transfers. Self-insured ERISA employer plans are exempt. Medicare and Health First Colorado (the state Medicaid program) do not cover IVF. Under the No Surprises Act, any patient paying out of pocket has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before the first appointment.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, un ciclo estandar de FIV en Colorado cuesta de $12,000 a $17,500 por el procedimiento base en la mayoria de las clinicas, mas $3,000 a $9,000 en medicamentos de fertilidad, para un total realista de $15,000 a $30,000 por ciclo. La Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado (HB20-1158, vigente desde enero de 2023, ampliada por HB24-1025 a partir de enero de 2025) exige cobertura de FIV para planes de grupo grande totalmente asegurados y, desde 2025, planes de grupo pequeno y planes individuales regulados por el estado, cubriendo tres recuperaciones de ovulos y transferencias ilimitadas de embriones. Los planes de empleadores autoasegurados bajo ERISA estan exentos. Medicare y Health First Colorado (el programa Medicaid del estado) no cubren la FIV.

introParagraphs.en: Colorado stands out among U.S. states for having one of the most comprehensive fertility insurance mandates in the country. The Colorado Building Families Act (originally HB20-1158, signed in 2020 and phased into effect beginning January 1, 2022) requires state-regulated health plans to cover infertility diagnosis, treatment, and fertility preservation, including up to three complete egg retrievals and unlimited embryo transfers. HB24-1025, effective January 1, 2025, removed the prior federal defrayal condition that had blocked coverage for individual and small-group markets, extending the mandate to those plan types. Despite this strong legal framework, a large share of Colorado workers remain uncovered because their employer operates a self-insured plan governed by federal ERISA law, which state mandates cannot reach.
introParagraphs.es: Colorado se destaca entre los estados de EE.UU. por tener uno de los mandatos de seguro de fertilidad mas completos del pais. La Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado (originalmente HB20-1158, promulgada en 2020 y con vigencia gradual desde el 1 de enero de 2022) exige que los planes de salud regulados por el estado cubran el diagnostico de infertilidad, el tratamiento y la preservacion de la fertilidad, incluidas hasta tres recuperaciones completas de ovulos y transferencias ilimitadas de embriones. HB24-1025, con vigencia desde el 1 de enero de 2025, elimino la condicion de financiamiento federal previo que habia bloqueado la cobertura para los mercados individuales y de grupo pequeno, extendiendo el mandato a esos tipos de planes.

introParagraphs.en: Colorado has one of the densest fertility clinic markets in the Mountain West. Colorado Center for Reproductive Medicine (CCRM Fertility) is headquartered in Lone Tree and operates multiple Colorado locations, including Denver, Louisville, and Colorado Springs. Other major providers include Conceptions Reproductive Associates (Denver and Littleton), Shady Grove Fertility (Greenwood Village and Colorado Springs), Denver Fertility Care (Denver), CNY Fertility (Colorado Springs monitoring site with Denver satellite), and the CU Anschutz Medical Campus Reproductive Endocrinology program in Aurora. Competition among these clinics creates meaningful variation in self-pay pricing, and some clinics offer income-based discounts or multi-cycle guarantee programs.
introParagraphs.es: Colorado tiene uno de los mercados de clinicas de fertilidad mas densos del occidente montanoso. Colorado Center for Reproductive Medicine (CCRM Fertility) tiene su sede en Lone Tree y opera multiples ubicaciones en Colorado, incluidas Denver, Louisville y Colorado Springs. Otros proveedores importantes incluyen Conceptions Reproductive Associates (Denver y Littleton), Shady Grove Fertility (Greenwood Village y Colorado Springs), Denver Fertility Care (Denver), CNY Fertility (sitio de monitoreo en Colorado Springs con satelite en Denver) y el programa de Endocrinologia Reproductiva del Campus Medico CU Anschutz en Aurora.

introParagraphs.en: This guide covers what IVF costs in Colorado in 2026 for patients paying out of pocket, which insurance plans must cover IVF under the Building Families Act, the ERISA self-insured gap that leaves many Colorado workers uncovered, how to compare clinic types, and how to request a Good Faith Estimate before starting treatment. Health First Colorado (Colorado Medicaid) and CHP+ do not cover IVF. For information on ACA marketplace plan rules or Medicaid income eligibility, see the linked guides.
introParagraphs.es: Esta guia cubre lo que cuesta la FIV en Colorado en 2026 para pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo, que planes de seguro deben cubrir la FIV bajo la Ley de Construyendo Familias, la brecha de planes autoasegurados bajo ERISA que deja a muchos trabajadores de Colorado sin cobertura, como comparar tipos de clinicas y como solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe antes de comenzar el tratamiento.

explanationParagraphs.en: Colorado IVF pricing in 2026 varies significantly by clinic type and location. Independent fertility clinics such as Conceptions Reproductive Associates in Denver publish base freeze-all IVF cycles at approximately $17,000, which includes egg retrieval, ICSI, blastocyst culture, and vitrification, but excludes anesthesia, medications, PGT, and embryo storage. CCRM Fertility, headquartered in Lone Tree with locations across the state, quotes IVF cycles in the $12,660 to $30,780 range depending on protocol complexity and whether a fresh or frozen transfer is planned. The same procedure at a hospital-affiliated academic center or a nationally branded clinic typically runs higher than at a smaller independent clinic because facility overhead, staffing, and equipment amortization costs are factored into the chargemaster rate.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los precios de FIV en Colorado en 2026 varian significativamente segun el tipo de clinica y la ubicacion. Las clinicas de fertilidad independientes como Conceptions Reproductive Associates en Denver publican ciclos de FIV de congelacion base a aproximadamente $17,000, lo que incluye la recuperacion de ovulos, ICSI, cultivo de blastocistos y vitrificacion, pero excluye anestesia, medicamentos, PGT y almacenamiento de embriones. CCRM Fertility, con sede en Lone Tree y ubicaciones en todo el estado, cotiza ciclos de FIV en el rango de $12,660 a $30,780 segun la complejidad del protocolo y si se planea una transferencia fresca o congelada.

explanationParagraphs.en: CNY Fertility operates a Colorado Springs clinic and Denver monitoring satellite, offering comprehensive self-pay IVF packages from $7,295 to $12,000 per cycle, one of the lowest price points in the state. CNY's model relies on remote monitoring for ultrasounds and bloodwork at local labs, with the egg retrieval performed at the Colorado Springs site. Patients in the Denver metro who use CNY pay an additional monitoring fee for local appointments. Multi-cycle package programs offered by several Colorado clinics bundle two to three cycles at a discount and often include a refund or credit guarantee if no live birth occurs, which can be cost-effective for patients who need multiple cycles.
explanationParagraphs.es: CNY Fertility opera una clinica en Colorado Springs y un satelite de monitoreo en Denver, ofreciendo paquetes completos de FIV de pago propio desde $7,295 hasta $12,000 por ciclo, uno de los precios mas bajos del estado. El modelo de CNY depende del monitoreo remoto para ecografias y analisis de sangre en laboratorios locales, con la recuperacion de ovulos realizada en el sitio de Colorado Springs.

explanationParagraphs.en: The listed ranges cover the base procedure only. Fertility medications are almost always billed separately and add $3,000 to $9,000 per cycle in Colorado, depending on the stimulation protocol. Optional add-ons, including preimplantation genetic testing (PGT), ICSI, embryo cryopreservation, and annual embryo storage, are typically extra at every clinic. Patients comparing Colorado clinic quotes should always confirm which components are included in the quoted price before signing any financial agreement.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los rangos indicados cubren solo el procedimiento base. Los medicamentos de fertilidad casi siempre se facturan por separado y agregan de $3,000 a $9,000 por ciclo en Colorado, segun el protocolo de estimulacion. Los complementos opcionales, incluidas las pruebas geneticas preimplantacionales (PGT), ICSI, criopreservacion de embriones y almacenamiento anual de embriones, son tipicamente adicionales en todas las clinicas.

paragraphs.en: Medicare does not cover IVF under any part of the program, including Original Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, or Part D. The exclusion is a federal program-level rule that applies in all 50 states, including Colorado. Medicare Part B covers medically necessary outpatient services, but assisted reproductive technology such as IVF is not among the covered benefits. Medicare Advantage plans are not required to add IVF coverage, and while a small number of Medicare Advantage plans offer fertility-related supplemental benefits, covering IVF itself is not mandated and is uncommon. Medigap supplemental policies follow Original Medicare and do not add IVF coverage. Patients on Medicare who are considering fertility treatment should review their plan's Evidence of Coverage document for any supplemental benefit details.
paragraphs.es: Medicare no cubre la FIV bajo ninguna parte del programa, incluida la Medicare Original Parte A, la Medicare Parte B o la Parte D. La exclusion es una regla a nivel de programa federal que aplica en los 50 estados, incluido Colorado. La Medicare Parte B cubre servicios ambulatorios medicamente necesarios, pero la tecnologia de reproduccion asistida como la FIV no figura entre los beneficios cubiertos. Los planes Medicare Advantage no estan obligados a agregar cobertura de FIV, y aunque un pequeno numero de planes Medicare Advantage ofrecen beneficios suplementarios relacionados con la fertilidad, la cobertura de la FIV en si no es obligatoria y es poco comun.

paragraphs.en: Health First Colorado, the state Medicaid program, does not cover IVF. Under federal Medicaid rules, states are not required to cover assisted reproductive technology, and Colorado has not elected to add IVF as a Medicaid benefit. CHP+ (Child Health Plan Plus, Colorado's CHIP program for children and pregnant women) also does not cover IVF. Diagnostic infertility testing, such as bloodwork, ultrasounds, and semen analysis, may be billable under Health First Colorado depending on clinical circumstances, but the IVF procedure itself is excluded. ACA-compliant plan coverage is governed by the Building Families Act mandate described separately: large-group fully-insured plans and, effective January 2025, small-group and individual state-regulated plans are required to cover up to three egg retrievals and unlimited transfers. Self-insured employer plans governed by federal ERISA law are not subject to the Colorado mandate.
paragraphs.es: Health First Colorado, el programa Medicaid del estado, no cubre la FIV. Bajo las reglas federales de Medicaid, los estados no estan obligados a cubrir la tecnologia de reproduccion asistida, y Colorado no ha optado por agregar la FIV como beneficio de Medicaid. CHP+ (el programa CHIP de Colorado para ninos y mujeres embarazadas) tampoco cubre la FIV. Las pruebas diagnosticas de infertilidad, como analisis de sangre, ecografias y analisis de semen, pueden ser facturables bajo Health First Colorado segun las circunstancias clinicas, pero el procedimiento de FIV en si esta excluido.

paragraphs.en: Commercial insurance plans in Colorado may cover IVF if they fall under the Building Families Act mandate. Patients with employer-sponsored coverage should verify with HR whether their plan is fully-insured (subject to the mandate) or self-insured (ERISA-exempt). For commercial plans that do cover IVF, cost-sharing generally mirrors other covered services: the plan cannot impose deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, benefit maximums, or waiting periods on fertility services that it does not also impose on other medical services. For ACA marketplace plans (individual and small-group plans on Connect for Health Colorado), the mandate extension effective January 2025 means those plans must also cover up to three retrievals and unlimited transfers.
paragraphs.es: Los planes de seguro comerciales en Colorado pueden cubrir la FIV si estan bajo el mandato de la Ley de Construyendo Familias. Los pacientes con cobertura patrocinada por el empleador deben verificar con Recursos Humanos si su plan es totalmente asegurado (sujeto al mandato) o autoasegurado (exento de ERISA). Para los planes comerciales que si cubren la FIV, el costo compartido generalmente refleja otros servicios cubiertos: el plan no puede imponer deducibles, copagos, coseguros, maximos de beneficios o periodos de espera en los servicios de fertilidad que no imponga tambien en otros servicios medicos.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any patient paying cash or who is uninsured has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate from the Colorado fertility clinic before treatment begins. For an IVF cycle scheduled at least 10 business days out, the clinic must furnish the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before the first billable service. For appointments scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, the Good Faith Estimate must arrive at least 1 business day before service. The federal consumer guidance is at healthcare.gov and the cms.gov/nosurprisesact portal. The Good Faith Estimate requirement covers all providers and facilities, including fertility clinics, regardless of whether the patient is insured or uninsured.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente que paga en efectivo o que no tiene seguro tiene derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito de la clinica de fertilidad de Colorado antes de que comience el tratamiento. Para un ciclo de FIV programado con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, la clinica debe proporcionar el Estimado de Buena Fe al menos 3 dias habiles antes del primer servicio facturable. Para citas programadas entre 3 y 9 dias habiles, el Estimado de Buena Fe debe llegar al menos 1 dia habil antes del servicio.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for IVF in Colorado in 2026, follow these steps: (1) Contact the fertility clinic and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured. (2) Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that itemizes the base cycle fee, anesthesia, monitoring visits, lab fees, medications if dispensed by the clinic, and each add-on you are considering such as ICSI, PGT, and embryo storage. (3) Provide your ZIP code, your diagnosis if known, and confirm which protocol add-ons apply. (4) Confirm the timing: the Good Faith Estimate arrives at least 3 business days before the first billable service if the cycle is scheduled 10 or more business days out, or at least 1 business day before service if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. (5) Keep the written Good Faith Estimate. If your final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe para FIV en Colorado en 2026, siga estos pasos: (1) Comuniquese con la clinica de fertilidad e identifiquese como paciente de pago propio o sin seguro. (2) Solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito que detalle la tarifa del ciclo base, anestesia, visitas de monitoreo, honorarios de laboratorio, medicamentos si son dispensados por la clinica y cada complemento que este considerando como ICSI, PGT y almacenamiento de embriones. (3) Proporcione su codigo postal, su diagnostico si lo conoce y confirme que complementos de protocolo aplican. (4) Confirme el tiempo: el Estimado de Buena Fe llega al menos 3 dias habiles antes del primer servicio facturable si el ciclo esta programado con 10 o mas dias habiles de anticipacion, o al menos 1 dia habil antes del servicio si esta programado entre 3 y 9 dias habiles. (5) Guarde el Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito. Si su factura final supera el Estimado de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas entre paciente y proveedor a traves del portal federal en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: Colorado IVF bills are highly itemized and common reasons a final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate include: more stimulation monitoring appointments than originally projected due to slow ovarian response, additional medications required mid-protocol, embryos developing to a stage that requires more extended culture, unexpected anesthesia complications or longer procedure time, and add-ons such as assisted hatching or additional PGT panels requested after the estimate was issued. Reviewing each line item on the final bill against the Good Faith Estimate is the fastest way to catch discrepancies before paying.
paragraphs.es: Las facturas de FIV en Colorado estan muy detalladas y las razones comunes por las que una factura final supera el Estimado de Buena Fe incluyen: mas citas de monitoreo de estimulacion de lo proyectado originalmente debido a una respuesta ovarica lenta, medicamentos adicionales requeridos en mitad del protocolo, embriones que se desarrollan a una etapa que requiere un cultivo mas extendido, complicaciones inesperadas de anestesia o mayor tiempo de procedimiento, y complementos como eclosion asistida o paneles PGT adicionales solicitados despues de emitir el estimado.

items.en: Insurance status under the Colorado Building Families Act: fully-insured large-group and, since January 2025, state-regulated small-group and individual plan members may have IVF covered at no additional cost-sharing. Self-insured ERISA employer plan members typically pay full cash price.
items.es: Estado del seguro bajo la Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado: los miembros de planes de grupo grande totalmente asegurados y, desde enero de 2025, los miembros de planes de grupo pequeno e individuales regulados por el estado pueden tener la FIV cubierta sin costo compartido adicional. Los miembros de planes de empleadores autoasegurados bajo ERISA tipicamente pagan el precio completo en efectivo.

items.en: Clinic type: independent fertility clinics in Colorado typically charge $12,000 to $17,500 per cycle, while hospital-affiliated or nationally branded academic centers such as CCRM charge up to $30,000 for the same base procedure due to higher facility overhead and chargemaster rates.
items.es: Tipo de clinica: las clinicas de fertilidad independientes en Colorado tipicamente cobran de $12,000 a $17,500 por ciclo, mientras que los centros academicos afiliados a hospitales o de marca nacional como CCRM cobran hasta $30,000 por el mismo procedimiento base debido a mayores gastos generales de instalacion y tarifas del chargemaster.

items.en: Independent fertility clinic cash-pay bundles: clinics such as CNY Fertility Colorado Springs offer self-pay package pricing from $7,295 to $12,000 inclusive of retrieval, ICSI, and cryopreservation, which is 30 to 60 percent below standard chargemaster rates at hospital-affiliated centers.
items.es: Paquetes de pago en efectivo de clinicas de fertilidad independientes: clinicas como CNY Fertility Colorado Springs ofrecen precios de paquete de pago propio desde $7,295 hasta $12,000 que incluyen recuperacion, ICSI y criopreservacion, lo que representa entre el 30 y el 60 por ciento menos que las tarifas estandar del chargemaster en centros afiliados a hospitales.

items.en: Hospital or clinic chargemaster discount asks: for patients paying out of pocket, most Colorado fertility clinics publish a self-pay discount or will negotiate on the base cycle rate, especially for patients who pay upfront in full. Some clinics apply the discount automatically when the patient identifies as self-pay; others require an explicit request to the patient financial services department.
items.es: Solicitudes de descuento del chargemaster hospitalario o de clinica: para pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo, la mayoria de las clinicas de fertilidad de Colorado publican un descuento de pago propio o negociaran sobre la tarifa del ciclo base, especialmente para pacientes que pagan por adelantado en su totalidad.

items.en: Medication protocol: higher stimulation doses mean more medication cost. In Colorado, injectable gonadotropins for a standard IVF cycle run $3,000 to $9,000 per cycle, billed separately from the procedure fee. Specialty pharmacy discounts and manufacturer patient assistance programs (available for some brand-name gonadotropins) can reduce this cost by $500 to $2,000 per cycle.
items.es: Protocolo de medicacion: dosis de estimulacion mas altas significan mayor costo de medicamentos. En Colorado, las gonadotropinas inyectables para un ciclo estandar de FIV cuestan de $3,000 a $9,000 por ciclo, facturadas por separado de la tarifa del procedimiento.

items.en: Number of IVF cycles: live birth rates per cycle vary by patient age and diagnosis. Patients under 35 may succeed in one cycle; patients over 38 often need two or three cycles. Each additional cycle multiplies the total out-of-pocket cost. Multi-cycle packages offered by Colorado clinics bundle two to three cycles at 10 to 20 percent below the per-cycle rate.
items.es: Numero de ciclos de FIV: las tasas de nacidos vivos por ciclo varian segun la edad y el diagnostico del paciente. Los pacientes menores de 35 anos pueden tener exito en un ciclo; los mayores de 38 anos a menudo necesitan dos o tres ciclos. Cada ciclo adicional multiplica el costo total de bolsillo.

items.en: Optional add-ons: preimplantation genetic testing adds $3,000 to $7,000 per cycle; ICSI adds $1,000 to $2,000 (often included in base packages, verify); donor eggs add $25,000 to $50,000 on top of the base cycle.
items.es: Complementos opcionales: las pruebas geneticas preimplantacionales agregan de $3,000 a $7,000 por ciclo; ICSI agrega de $1,000 a $2,000 (a menudo incluido en paquetes base, verifique); los ovulos de donante agregan de $25,000 a $50,000 ademas del ciclo base.

items.en: Geographic location within Colorado: Denver Tech Center and northern suburbs (Greenwood Village, Lone Tree, Louisville) clinics generally charge more than Colorado Springs or Fort Collins clinics due to higher operating costs. Patients willing to travel to a Colorado Springs or Littleton clinic can save $2,000 to $5,000 per cycle.
items.es: Ubicacion geografica dentro de Colorado: las clinicas del Denver Tech Center y los suburbios del norte (Greenwood Village, Lone Tree, Louisville) generalmente cobran mas que las clinicas de Colorado Springs o Fort Collins debido a mayores costos operativos.

intro.en: IVF billing in Colorado is complex and heavily itemized. If your final bill is significantly higher than your clinic's upfront quote or Good Faith Estimate, check for these common errors before paying:
intro.es: La facturacion de FIV en Colorado es compleja y muy detallada. Si su factura final es significativamente mas alta que la cotizacion inicial o el Estimado de Buena Fe de la clinica, verifique estos errores comunes antes de pagar:

items.en: Medications billed at retail pharmacy prices when a specialty pharmacy or clinic-dispensed price was available at lower cost. Ask before treatment which pharmacy your clinic uses and whether a mail-order fertility pharmacy offers a lower price.
items.es: Medicamentos facturados a precios de farmacia minorista cuando habia disponible un precio de farmacia especializada o dispensada por la clinica a menor costo. Pregunte antes del tratamiento que farmacia usa su clinica y si una farmacia de fertilidad por correo ofrece un precio mas bajo.

items.en: ICSI billed for all eggs retrieved when it was performed on only a subset of eggs. Request the embryology lab report confirming exactly how many eggs received ICSI.
items.es: ICSI facturado por todos los ovulos recuperados cuando solo se realizo en un subconjunto de ovulos. Solicite el informe del laboratorio de embriologia que confirme exactamente cuantos ovulos recibieron ICSI.

items.en: PGT biopsy fee charged for embryos that were never biopsied due to poor development or early arrest before reaching biopsy stage.
items.es: Tarifa de biopsia PGT cobrada por embriones que nunca fueron biopsiados debido a un desarrollo deficiente o arresto temprano antes de alcanzar la etapa de biopsia.

en.question: How much does IVF cost in Colorado without insurance in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance in 2026, a standard IVF cycle in Colorado costs $12,000 to $17,500 at most independent fertility clinics for the base procedure. Adding fertility medications ($3,000 to $9,000) brings the realistic all-in total to $15,000 to $30,000 per cycle. Hospital-affiliated or nationally branded centers such as CCRM quote up to $30,000 per cycle. Low-cost options like CNY Fertility in Colorado Springs offer self-pay packages from $7,295 to $12,000 inclusive of retrieval, ICSI, and cryopreservation. Most self-pay patients in Colorado are covered by self-insured ERISA employer plans exempt from the state mandate, or are on Medicare or Medicaid, neither of which covers IVF.

en.question: Does Colorado require insurance to cover IVF?
en.answer: Yes, partially. Colorado's Building Families Act (HB20-1158) requires fully-insured large-group health plans to cover up to three egg retrievals and unlimited embryo transfers, with no extra deductibles or copays beyond what applies to other medical services. HB24-1025, effective January 1, 2025, extended the mandate to small-group and individual plans regulated by the state, removing the prior federal defrayal prerequisite. The critical exception: self-insured employer plans governed by federal ERISA law are exempt from state mandates. Employees should ask HR whether their plan is fully-insured or self-insured. Health First Colorado (Medicaid) and CHP+ do not cover IVF regardless of plan type.

en.question: What does Medicare pay for IVF in Colorado?
en.answer: Medicare pays nothing for IVF in Colorado or any other state. Original Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, and Medicare Part D all exclude assisted reproductive technology. Medicare Part B covers medically necessary outpatient services, but IVF is not among them. Medicare Advantage plans are not required to cover IVF, and Medigap supplements do not add fertility benefits beyond what Original Medicare covers. The 2026 Medicare Part B deductible is $283 and the standard coinsurance is 20%, but these figures apply to covered services only, which does not include IVF. Patients on Medicare exploring fertility options should review their Medicare Advantage plan's Evidence of Coverage for any supplemental benefit language.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for IVF in Colorado?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act, any self-pay or uninsured patient has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before IVF treatment begins. Call the Colorado fertility clinic and identify yourself as self-pay. Ask for an itemized Good Faith Estimate that includes the base cycle fee, monitoring visits, anesthesia, lab fees, and any add-ons such as ICSI, PGT, and embryo storage. Confirm the timing rule: the Good Faith Estimate must arrive at least 3 business days before the first billable service if your cycle is scheduled 10 or more business days out, or at least 1 business day before service if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. Keep the written estimate. If your final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to IVF in Colorado?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, is a federal law that protects patients from unexpected medical bills. For IVF patients in Colorado paying out of pocket or who are uninsured, the No Surprises Act requires the fertility clinic and any associated providers to furnish a written Good Faith Estimate of all expected charges before treatment begins. If the final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, the patient can file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim within 120 days through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. The law covers all providers and facilities in Colorado, including independent fertility clinics and hospital-affiliated reproductive medicine centers.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for IVF in Colorado?
en.answer: Call the fertility clinic's patient financial services department before your first appointment and ask specifically for the self-pay or cash-pay price for the procedure components you need. Request an itemized breakdown covering the base cycle, monitoring, anesthesia, lab fees, and each add-on you are considering. Get the quote in writing as a Good Faith Estimate. Compare quotes from at least two to three Colorado clinics, as prices vary by $3,000 to $5,000 for the same services. Ask whether a same-day payment discount applies, whether a multi-cycle package reduces the per-cycle rate, and whether specialty pharmacy pricing is available for medications rather than retail pharmacy pricing.

en.question: Can I negotiate an IVF bill in Colorado after treatment?
en.answer: Yes. Even after receiving a bill, Colorado IVF patients can negotiate. Most fertility clinics will consider a cash-pay-now reduction of 10 to 30 percent if you offer to pay the balance in full immediately. If your final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, the No Surprises Act entitles you to use the federal patient-provider dispute resolution process at cms.gov/nosurprisesact within 120 days of the bill date. Before paying any bill, request an itemized statement and cross-check each line against the Good Faith Estimate to identify any charges for services not rendered or for add-ons not agreed to in writing.

en.question: What is the difference between a fully-insured and self-insured plan for IVF coverage in Colorado?
en.answer: This distinction determines whether Colorado's Building Families Act applies to your plan. A fully-insured plan is one your employer purchases from an insurance carrier. Colorado's mandate requires those plans to cover three egg retrievals and unlimited embryo transfers with no special cost-sharing. A self-insured plan is one where the employer bears the financial risk directly, typically administered by an insurance carrier on paper but funded by the employer. Federal ERISA law governs self-insured plans, and state insurance mandates like the Building Families Act cannot apply. Most large employers (1,000-plus employees) use self-insured plans. Ask your HR department or review your plan's Summary Plan Description to confirm which type you have before assuming IVF is covered.

en.question: Is IVF covered by ACA marketplace plans in Colorado?
en.answer: Yes, for individual and small-group ACA marketplace plans regulated by Colorado that are issued or renewed on or after January 1, 2025. HB24-1025 extended the Building Families Act mandate to those plans by removing the prior federal defrayal prerequisite. Connect for Health Colorado (the state ACA marketplace) now offers plans that must cover up to three egg retrievals and unlimited embryo transfers with no additional cost-sharing beyond normal plan cost-sharing. However, grandfathered plans and self-insured employer plans offered through the marketplace are not subject to the mandate. Verify your specific plan's Summary of Benefits before assuming IVF is covered at no extra cost.

en.question: How does IVF cost in Colorado compare to IVF cost in other states?
en.answer: Colorado's Building Families Act makes it one of the most favorable states for insured patients needing IVF coverage, covering three retrievals and unlimited transfers with no extra cost-sharing for mandate-eligible plans. For self-pay patients, Colorado pricing is mid-range nationally. States without IVF mandates such as Virginia, Georgia, and Florida have similar or slightly lower self-pay prices ($13,000 to $17,500 per cycle), but patients there pay everything out of pocket. States with strong mandates and large clinic markets, such as Illinois and Massachusetts, have similar mandated coverage but may have higher base prices due to market concentration. Self-pay patients willing to travel can consider CNY Fertility, which operates across multiple states with package pricing from $5,495 to $12,000 per cycle.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta la FIV en Colorado sin seguro en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro en 2026, un ciclo estandar de FIV en Colorado cuesta de $12,000 a $17,500 en la mayoria de las clinicas de fertilidad independientes para el procedimiento base. Agregar medicamentos de fertilidad ($3,000 a $9,000) lleva el total realista a $15,000 a $30,000 por ciclo. Los centros afiliados a hospitales o de marca nacional como CCRM cotizan hasta $30,000 por ciclo. Las opciones de bajo costo como CNY Fertility en Colorado Springs ofrecen paquetes de pago propio desde $7,295 hasta $12,000 que incluyen recuperacion, ICSI y criopreservacion.

es.question: Exige Colorado a los seguros cubrir la FIV?
es.answer: Si, parcialmente. La Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado (HB20-1158) exige que los planes de salud de grupo grande totalmente asegurados cubran hasta tres recuperaciones de ovulos y transferencias ilimitadas de embriones, sin deducibles ni copagos adicionales. HB24-1025, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2025, extendio el mandato a los planes de grupo pequeno e individuales regulados por el estado. La excepcion critica: los planes de empleadores autoasegurados regidos por la ley federal ERISA estan exentos del mandato estatal. Health First Colorado (Medicaid) y CHP+ no cubren la FIV independientemente del tipo de plan.

es.question: Cuanto paga Medicare por la FIV en Colorado?
es.answer: Medicare no paga nada por la FIV en Colorado ni en ningun otro estado. La Medicare Original Parte A, la Medicare Parte B y la Medicare Parte D excluyen la tecnologia de reproduccion asistida. Los planes Medicare Advantage no estan obligados a cubrir la FIV, y los suplementos Medigap no agregan beneficios de fertilidad mas alla de lo que cubre la Medicare Original. El deducible de la Medicare Parte B 2026 es $283 y el coseguro estandar es del 20%, pero estas cifras solo aplican a los servicios cubiertos, que no incluyen la FIV.

es.question: Como solicito un Estimado de Buena Fe para FIV en Colorado?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, cualquier paciente que paga de su bolsillo o sin seguro tiene derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito antes de que comience el tratamiento de FIV. Llame a la clinica de fertilidad de Colorado e identifiquese como paciente de pago propio. Solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe detallado que incluya la tarifa del ciclo base, visitas de monitoreo, anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio y cualquier complemento como ICSI, PGT y almacenamiento de embriones. Si su factura final supera el estimado en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica a la FIV en Colorado?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, es una ley federal que protege a los pacientes de facturas medicas inesperadas. Para los pacientes de FIV en Colorado que pagan de su bolsillo o sin seguro, la Ley de No Sorpresas exige que la clinica de fertilidad proporcione un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito de todos los cargos esperados antes de que comience el tratamiento. Si la factura final supera el Estimado de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, el paciente puede presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas dentro de los 120 dias siguientes en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion de pago en efectivo para FIV en Colorado?
es.answer: Llame al departamento de servicios financieros para pacientes de la clinica de fertilidad antes de su primera cita y pregunte especificamente por el precio de pago propio o en efectivo para los componentes del procedimiento que necesita. Solicite un desglose detallado que cubra el ciclo base, monitoreo, anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio y cada complemento que este considerando. Obtenga la cotizacion por escrito como Estimado de Buena Fe. Compare cotizaciones de al menos dos o tres clinicas de Colorado, ya que los precios varian entre $3,000 y $5,000 por los mismos servicios.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de FIV en Colorado despues del tratamiento?
es.answer: Si. Incluso despues de recibir una factura, los pacientes de FIV en Colorado pueden negociar. La mayoria de las clinicas de fertilidad consideraran una reduccion de pago en efectivo inmediato del 10 al 30 por ciento si ofrece pagar el saldo en su totalidad de inmediato. Si su factura final supera el Estimado de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, la Ley de No Sorpresas le otorga el derecho de usar el proceso federal de resolucion de disputas en cms.gov/nosurprisesact dentro de los 120 dias de la fecha de la factura. Antes de pagar cualquier factura, solicite un estado de cuenta detallado y compare cada linea con el Estimado de Buena Fe.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre un plan totalmente asegurado y un plan autoasegurado para la cobertura de FIV en Colorado?
es.answer: Esta distincion determina si la Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado aplica a su plan. Un plan totalmente asegurado es uno que su empleador compra a una aseguradora. Los planes autoasegurados son financiados directamente por el empleador y estan regidos por la ley federal ERISA, por lo que los mandatos estatales como la Ley de Construyendo Familias no pueden aplicarse. La mayoria de los grandes empleadores (1,000 o mas empleados) usan planes autoasegurados. Pregunte a su departamento de Recursos Humanos o revise la Descripcion del Plan de Su Plan para confirmar que tipo tiene antes de asumir que la FIV esta cubierta.

es.question: Esta cubierta la FIV por los planes del mercado ACA en Colorado?
es.answer: Si, para los planes individuales y de grupo pequeno del mercado ACA regulados por Colorado que sean emitidos o renovados a partir del 1 de enero de 2025. HB24-1025 extendio el mandato de la Ley de Construyendo Familias a esos planes al eliminar el prerequisito federal de financiamiento previo. Connect for Health Colorado (el mercado estatal de ACA) ahora ofrece planes que deben cubrir hasta tres recuperaciones de ovulos y transferencias ilimitadas de embriones sin costo compartido adicional. Sin embargo, los planes consolidados y los planes de empleadores autoasegurados ofrecidos a traves del mercado no estan sujetos al mandato.

es.question: Como se compara el costo de FIV en Colorado con el costo en otros estados?
es.answer: La Ley de Construyendo Familias de Colorado la convierte en uno de los estados mas favorables para los pacientes asegurados que necesitan cobertura de FIV, cubriendo tres recuperaciones y transferencias ilimitadas sin costo compartido adicional para los planes elegibles por mandato. Para los pacientes de pago propio, los precios de Colorado son intermedios a nivel nacional. Los estados sin mandatos de FIV como Virginia, Georgia y Florida tienen precios de pago propio similares o ligeramente mas bajos ($13,000 a $17,500 por ciclo), pero los pacientes pagan todo de su bolsillo. Los pacientes de pago propio dispuestos a viajar pueden considerar CNY Fertility, que opera en multiples estados con precios de paquete desde $5,495 hasta $12,000 por ciclo.
